title: Questions
description: Frequently asked questions about visiting Casa Meyer.

blocks.html: Answers to the questions we are asked most often. If yours is not here, write to us.

blocks.question: Can I visit without an appointment?
blocks.html: No. The house is a private home and is opened only for arranged visits. Request a date on the Visits page and we will confirm by email.

blocks.question: How many people can come?
blocks.html: [Group size to be confirmed.] Larger groups can be split across two slots.

blocks.question: Is the house accessible?
blocks.html: [Accessibility notes: steps at the entrance, the stair, the garden paths. To be confirmed.]

blocks.question: May I take photographs?
blocks.html: Photographs for personal use are welcome. Tripods, lighting and commercial photography need prior arrangement.

blocks.question: Where is the house?
blocks.html: In Bosques de las Lomas, in the west of Mexico City. The exact address is sent with your confirmation.
